Same image, same instruction, one audited correct and one audited wrong

The cleanest pairs the release can give: the same label annotated twice on the same image, where a human audit marked one version correct and the other clear_error. Nothing is constructed - both sides are real annotations, and the verdict is a person's, not a model's. A full scan of all 223,572 images finds 2,204 such pairs across 2,081 images, so this is a high-quality seed rather than a training set on its own. Green shading is the release's own mask where one exists.
